trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Pure-data table; ten trap categories n/a. EVERY knot identification recomputed and correct: trefoil = T_{2,3}; cinquefoil = 5_1 = T_{2,5}; septafoil = 7_1 = T_{2,7}; 4_1 is amphichiral; Borromean rings are 6^3_2 in Rolfsen link notation (6 crossings, 3 components). The generation index is consistent - T_{2,2m+1} for deg alpha_V = m = 1,2,3. TWO CROSS-BLOCK FLAGS for the report. (1) This table assigns 4_1 to the HIGGS and T_{2,5} to the MUON, while prop:three-halves-structural-factor writes 'Muon (m = 2, K_mu = 4_1)' and closes m_mu/m_e via Vol(4_1), and rem:topological-mass-trefoil computes Vol(4_1)/hbar^2 and calls the result the muon-to-electron ratio. (2) Muon and tau are assigned TORUS knots here, and two other blocks in this same batch (prop:thurston-volume-additivity, rem:torus-knot-zero-volume-via-reeb) establish that torus knots have zero hyperbolic volume - so a Vol(K)/hbar_q^2 mass for the muon is identically zero under this table's assignment. No block reconciles the two.
